RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  April 26, 2010/V aisakha 6, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Reduction  in grants-in-aid to NGOs
*421. SHRI RANJITSINH
VIJAYSINH MOHITE-PATIL:  Will the
Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  his Ministry has decided
to reduce grants-in-aid  in the next financial
year for the Non-Governmental
Organisations (NGOs) working under new
and renewable energy sources;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the budgetary allocations made for
this purpose under the grants-in-aid to
NGOs during 2007-08, 2008-09 and
2009-10; and
(d) the details of grants already
sanctioned to various NGOs and the
Utilisation Certificates submitted by them
during those years?
Forest cover
*422.  SHRI KISHORE KUMAR
MOHANTY: W ill the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) the area in hectares and in percentage
terms, which  is under forest cover in the
country, State-wise;
(b) the national average of forest cover
in hectares and percentage;
(c) whether Government proposes to
launch a new initiative to expand forest
cover in the country ;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken to compensate Orissa;
(e) the scheme-wise details of the funds
provided by Government to the States
including Orissa for conservation,
development and promotion of forests
during  the last three years and the current
year, State-wise and year-wise; and
(f) the achievements made, as a result
thereof?
129

130
Regional imbalance in power sector
†*423.  SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will
the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the vast
variance in country's energy resources is
due to regional variance in terms of natural
resources, thereby leading to some regions
having adequate power while others hardly
having  any power;
(b) if so, whether any coordinating
agency is working at  national level to
remove this variance; and
(c) if not,  whether  setting up of any
such coordinating agency is being
considered?
Environmental clearance to irrigation,
road and infrastructure projects
†*424.  SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN :
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that a large
number of proposals, including proposals
relating to irrigation, road and
infrastructural development, are pending
before  Government for environmental
clearance under the Forest (Conservation)
Act, 1980;
(b) if so, the details thereof as on date
and the reasons therefor, State-wise;
(c) whether Government  plans to
simplify the process relating to the
environmental clearance to various projects;
(d) if so, the details thereof;  and
(e) the extent to which the simplification
of the environmental  clearance process
would be helpful in according clearance to
the pending projects?
Malnutrition in Orissa
*425.  SHRIMATI RENUBALA
PRADHAN: Will the Minister of
WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has conducted
any study to identify the level of
malnutrition among children in rural and
urban areas in Orissa;
(b) if so, the details thereof;  and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Modification in environmental
regulations
*426.  SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Gujarat has
1600 Km long coastline and some
modification in the State's environmental
regulations is required;
(b) whether any proposal to modify the
State's environmental regulations is being
considered by the Central Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof;  and
(d) if not, the  reasons therefor?
Employment in FIIs
*427.  SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI :
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  the food processing industry
is employment intensive and for investment
of  every Rs. 1 crore it creates 18 jobs directly
and  64 indirectly in the organized sector
and 20 jobs in the unorganized sector across
the supply chain;

and
(c) the future action plan prepared so
far?

on-going power crisis in Karnataka;
